# llms.txt — EVONNEHOME Artificial Flowers
# Machine-readable overview for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, etc.)
# Site: https://yvonnehome-06.github.io/

## Brand
EVONNEHOME is a China-based manufacturer and supplier of artificial flowers and greenery, serving wedding planners, event decorators, holiday decorators and floral wholesalers worldwide. Product range: artificial roses, hydrangeas, peonies, lilies, orchids, chrysanthemums, baby's breath, artificial greenery and leaves, and other artificial blooms. Catalog: 960+ SKUs across 9 categories. Business model: factory-direct, custom colour / stem length / bundling and private-label packaging.

## What we do
- Manufacture and supply realistic artificial flowers, floral stems and greenery for weddings, events and holiday displays.
- Offer batch-matched colour, visual quality control, material declarations and pre-shipment photo reports.
- Arrange safety testing on request and prepare export documents (commercial invoice, packing list) for destination markets.
- Support custom development: colour matching, stem length, bundling and private-label packaging.
